title: Step dereferences Commands without a null check when NumCommands > 0
detail: Step(S, 1, nullptr, 2) is undefined behavior — the (nullptr, >0) argument pair has no guard; every current caller passes a valid pointer or zero.
recommended_fix: Guard 'if (NumCommands > 0 && !Commands) { State.ReplayError = true; return; }' or assert.

title: Demand scheduled at tick 0 can never fire
detail: FlowSeedDemand(F, 0, ...) is silently dead: Step never runs at tick 0 (same-tick latch on a fresh state), and no validation rejects a zero-tick demand entry.
recommended_fix: Validate Tick >= 1 in FlowSeedDemand (fail loud) — mirroring the FSpawnReq contract the spawn pass assumes.

title: SpawnNode accepts any int32 coordinates; Dist2 can overflow int64 (UB) inside the span-validation path
detail: Two extreme int32 positions differ by ~2^32; Dx*Dx overflows int64 (signed-overflow UB) inside SpanBetween, which ValidateDraw's span rule then trusts. Latent: slice-1 callers pass small fixture coords.
recommended_fix: Clamp/validate X,Y against map bounds (kMapTilesX/Y) in SpawnNode, or widen the Dist2 intermediates.

title: EqualCostHops(from == dst) always reports no route — self-reachability is unhandled
detail: HasPath(R, T, N, N) returns false for a node reaching itself; no guard documents the semantic. FlowStep never hits it (AtNode==Dst delivers first), but direct callers get a surprising answer.
recommended_fix: Document count==0 for (x,x) as 'self — no hop needed', or special-case it in EqualCostHops.

title: FlowSeedDemand/FlowSpawn accept Src/Dst node ids without existence validation
detail: A demand entry naming a nonexistent node spawns a packet that waits forever (EqualCostHops fails), is never culled (cull drops only Delivered), and rides the serialized state. Latent: current callers pass fixture ids.
recommended_fix: When demand becomes external (3.1 director/catalogs), validate Src/Dst existence fail-fast at FlowSeedDemand entry, mirroring ValidateDraw.
